symbols.name: input array
symbols.meaning: The first input array of records; $\varphi_a$ is its record at address $a$.
symbols.quote: The two input arrays are $\varphi$ and $\psi$, with records $\varphi_a,\psi_b\in R_r$ at addresses $a$ and $b$.

symbols.name: second input array
symbols.meaning: The second input array of records; $\psi_b$ is its record at address $b$.
symbols.quote: The two input arrays are $\varphi$ and $\psi$, with records $\varphi_a,\psi_b\in R_r$ at addresses $a$ and $b$.

symbols.name: record address
symbols.meaning: An address of the first input array, which indexes its records.
symbols.quote: The two input arrays are $\varphi$ and $\psi$, with records $\varphi_a,\psi_b\in R_r$ at addresses $a$ and $b$.

symbols.name: record address
symbols.meaning: An address of the second input array, which indexes its records.
symbols.quote: The two input arrays are $\varphi$ and $\psi$, with records $\varphi_a,\psi_b\in R_r$ at addresses $a$ and $b$.

symbols.name: axis length
symbols.meaning: The length of axis $i$, the number of positions on that axis.
symbols.quote: Axis $i$ has length $t_i$, and $\mu=\prod_i t_i$ is the number of records in an array

symbols.name: record count
symbols.meaning: The number of records in an array, the product of the axis lengths.
symbols.quote: Axis $i$ has length $t_i$, and $\mu=\prod_i t_i$ is the number of records in an array

symbols.name: axis root of unity
symbols.meaning: A root of unity of order $t$ on an axis of length $t$, equal to $y^{2r/t}$.
symbols.quote: On an axis of length $t$, $\omega_t=y^{2r/t}$ is a root of unity of order $t$

symbols.name: forward transform
symbols.meaning: The forward transform of an array $u$, with entries $\hat u_j$.
symbols.quote: The forward transform $\hat u$ of an array $u$ has entries

symbols.name: opposite transform
symbols.meaning: The opposite transform of an array $u$, with entries $\check u_c$.
symbols.quote: The opposite transform $\check u$ has entries

symbols.name: frequency address
symbols.meaning: An integer index of a transform entry, one entry per axis.
symbols.quote: A frequency address $j$ is an integer index of a transform entry

symbols.name: summation index
symbols.meaning: The index of the sum on an axis, running over the $t$ positions of that axis.

symbols.name: normalized convolution
symbols.meaning: The convolution of two arrays divided by $r\mu$, the product of the record length and the record count.

symbols.name: entrywise product
symbols.meaning: The product of two arrays entry by entry, divided by the record length $r$.

symbols.name: real integer polynomial
symbols.meaning: The integer polynomial of degree less than $r$ whose $2^{-p}$-scaled value is the real part of $\varphi$.
symbols.quote: Let $\varphi_1$ and $\varphi_2$ be the real and imaginary integer polynomials of $\varphi$

symbols.name: imaginary integer polynomial
symbols.meaning: The integer polynomial of degree less than $r$ whose $2^{-p}$-scaled value is the imaginary part of $\varphi$.
symbols.quote: Let $\varphi_1$ and $\varphi_2$ be the real and imaginary integer polynomials of $\varphi$

symbols.name: real part of psi
symbols.meaning: The integer polynomial of degree less than $r$ whose $2^{-p}$-scaled value is the real part of $\psi$.

symbols.name: imaginary part of psi
symbols.meaning: The integer polynomial of degree less than $r$ whose $2^{-p}$-scaled value is the imaginary part of $\psi$.

symbols.name: record length exponent
symbols.meaning: The integer exponent with $r=2^\ell$, the base-two logarithm of the record length.

relations.quote: Convolution over the polynomial ring takes its products in the [Polynomial ring modulo y^r + 1](polynomial-ring-mod-yr-plus-1.md)
Convolution over the polynomial ring computes its transforms by [synthetic polynomial transforms](synthetic-transforms.md)
Convolution over the polynomial ring computes its record products by [signed coefficient packing](signed-packing.md)
Convolution over the polynomial ring reads each coefficient as the [centered residue](centered-residue.md)
Convolution over the polynomial ring extracts its blocks by a [carry scan](carry-propagation.md)
Convolution over the polynomial ring is computed along the [remaining axes](transform-axis.md)
holds each coefficient as [fixed-width digit blocks](fixed-width-digit-blocks.md)
